title: vcpkg overlay port directory
description: vcpkg-configuration.json declares an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files. A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files.
remediation: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files.
limitation: It matches an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files in the parsed vcpkg-configuration.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
